arxiv-2012-00513.title: DNA mixture deconvolution using an evolutionary algorithm with multiple populations, hill-climbing, and guided mutation
arxiv-2012-00513.creator: Søren B. Vilsen, Torben Tvedebrink, Poul Svante Eriksen
arxiv-2012-00513.description: Abstract DNA samples crime cases analysed in forensic genetics, frequently contain DNA from multiple contributors. These occur as convolutions of the DNA profiles of the individual contributors to the DNA sample. Thus, in cases where one or more of the contributors were unknown, an objective of interest would be the separation, often called deconvolution, of these unknown profiles.

The recent availability of large-scale human movement data collected from mobile devices have enabled the development of complex human mobility prediction models.

arxiv-2406-17129.creator: Abhisek Bandyopadhyay, S. Lee, D. T. Adroja, M. R. Lees, G. B. G. Stenning, P. Aich, Luca Tortora, C. Meneghini, G. Cibin, Adam Berlie, R. A. Saha, D. Takegami, A. Meléndez-Sans, G. Poelchen, M. Yoshimura, K. D. Tsuei, Z. Hu, Ting-Shan Chan, S. Chattopadhyay, G. S. Thakur, Kwang-Yong Choi
arxiv-2406-17129.description: Abstract We present an experimental investigation of the magnetic ground state in Ba 4 NbIr 3 O 12 , a fractional valent trimer iridate. X-ray absorption and photoemission spectroscopy show that the Ir valence lies between 3+ and 4+ while Nb is pentavalent.

arxiv-2501-01300.title: Thermodynamics of charmed hadrons across chiral crossover from lattice QCD
arxiv-2501-01300.creator: Sipaz Sharma, Frithjof Karsch, Peter Petreczky
arxiv-2501-01300.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sipaz Sharma, Frithjof Karsch, Peter Petreczky. We use up to fourth-order charm fluctuations and their correlations with net baryon number, electric charge, and strangeness fluctuations, calculated within the framework of lattice QCD, to study the continuum partial pressure contributions of charmed baryons and mesons. We show that, at and below the chiral crossover temperature, these partial pressures receive enhanced contributions from experimentally unobserved charmed hadrons predicted by the Quark Model.

arxiv-2503-08381.title: InfluenceNet: AI Models for Banzhaf and Shapley Value Prediction
arxiv-2503-08381.creator: Benjamin Kempinski 1,2, Tal Kachman 1,2,
arxiv-2503-08381.description: Abstract Power indices are essential in assessing the contribution and influence of individual agents in multi-agent systems, providing crucial insights into collaborative dynamics and decision-making processes. While invaluable, traditional computational methods for exact or estimated power indices values require significant time and computational constraints, especially for large ( n ≥ 10 ) (n\geq 10) coalitions.

arxiv-2503-12852.title: ACT360: An Efficient 360-Degree Action Detection and Summarization Framework for Mission-Critical Training and Debriefing
arxiv-2503-12852.creator: 1 Given Name Surname, 2 Given Name Surname, Aditi Tiwari, Klara Nahrstedt
arxiv-2503-12852.description: Abstract Effective training and debriefing are critical in high-stakes, mission-critical environments such as disaster response, military simulations, and industrial safety, where precision and minimizing errors are paramount. The traditional post-training analysis relies on manually reviewing 2-dimensional (2D) videos, a time-consuming process that lacks comprehensive situational awareness.

arxiv-2505-11723.title: Introduction to Quantum Combinatorics
arxiv-2505-11723.creator: Tomasz Maszczyk
arxiv-2505-11723.description: Abstract We construct a topos of quantum sets and embed into it the classical topos of sets. We show that the internal logic of the topos of sets, when interpreted in the topos of quantum sets, provides the Birkhoff-von Neumann quantum propositional calculus of idempotents in a canonical internal commutative algebra of the topos of quantum sets.

pmc-10660758.title: Nurse Manager Span of Control in Hospital Settings: An Integrative Review
pmc-10660758.creator: Angel Boned-Galán, Nieves López-Ibort, Ana Gascón-Catalán, Richard Gray
pmc-10660758.description: Background: Nurse managers face great challenges in responding to organizational demands. There exists a general mismatch between managerial span of control and the demands of the job post, which can lead to overburdening and attrition. The aim of this review was to identify the effects of the nurse manager span of control on hospital organizations.

pmc-11583537.title: Impact of online expert interview-based research training on medical trainees’ knowledge and confidence: a mixed-methods design
pmc-11583537.creator: Arif Alper Cevik, Fikri M Abu-Zidan
pmc-11583537.description: BackgroundResearch training is important for medical trainees, because it improves their critical thinking, problem-solving, and the application of scientific principles to clinical practice. The COVID-19 Pandemic, which limited trainees’ access to hospitals, had also disrupted traditional research training. The International Emergency Medicine Education Project introduced the online Fundamentals of Research in Medicine course to support trainees.

pmc-11644313.title: The Design and Implementation of Kerberos-Blockchain Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks Authentication Across Diverse Network Scenarios †
pmc-11644313.creator: Maya Rahayu, Md. Biplob Hossain, Samsul Huda, Yuta Kodera, Md. Arshad Ali, Yasuyuki Nogami
pmc-11644313.description: Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs) play an essential role in the intelligent transportation era, furnishing users with essential roadway data to facilitate optimal route selection and mitigate the risk of accidents. However, the network exposure makes VANETs susceptible to cyber threats, making authentication crucial for ensuring security and integrity.

pmc-11716894.title: Exploring heterogeneity in Motoric Cognitive Risk Syndrome using Volumetric MRI‐guided Clustering
pmc-11716894.creator: Bhargav Teja Nallapu, Helena M Blumen, Kellen K. Petersen, Richard B. Lipton, V.G. Pradeep, Velandai K Srikanth, Richard Beare, Olivier Beauchet, Sofiya Milman, Sandra Aleksic, Ali Ezzati, Joe Verghese
pmc-11716894.description: BackgroundThe Motoric Cognitive Risk Syndrome (MCR) is a predementia stage characterized by slow gait speed and subjective cognitive complaints. Defining the heterogeneity of brain volumetrics in individuals with MCR will improve current dementia risk assessments.MethodWe used data from 6 cohorts from the MCR consortium (N=2,007). We used K‐means clustering algorithm guided by volumetric MRI to identify distinct subgroups of participants.

pmc-12597016.title: Dataset of rolling circle amplification (RCA) enriched metagenome of Cassava obtained through nanopore sequencing
pmc-12597016.creator: Olabode Onile-ere, Pakyendou Estel Name, Ezechiel Bionimian Tibiri, Fidèle Tiendrébéogo, Justin Pita, Ibrahim Umar Mohammed, Chukwuemeka K Nkere, Solomon Oranusi, Angela Eni
pmc-12597016.description: The dataset presented here was obtained by sequencing selected historic herbarium cassava samples collected across Nigeria. Total DNA was extracted from the samples using the CTAB method, after which the samples were enriched by Rolling Circle Amplification (RCA) and then sequenced on the MinION.

pmc-12859970.title: m6A-mediated DEC1 upregulation facilitates silica-induced pulmonary fibrosis via PI3K/Akt signaling pathway
pmc-12859970.creator: Haoyu Yin, Shiyu Yang, Yujia Xie, Xiaojie You, Yuxin Yao, Bingxin Shang, Haoxiang Liu, Xin Fan, Xin Lin, Jixuan Ma
pmc-12859970.description: BackgroundSilicosis is a severe and globally prevalent lung disease characterized by progressive pulmonary fibrosis. Recent studies suggested that N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modification is implicated in the pathogenesis of lung diseases. However, the function role of m6A modification in silicosis is still mostly unknown.

pmc-13245460.title: Clinical Artificial Intelligence Implementation in Routine Care: Real-World Operational Outcomes from a Provincial Health System in China
pmc-13245460.creator: Jin Tian, Yongzhao Song, Longmei Tang, Lejiao An, Jin Zhou
pmc-13245460.description: BackgroundClinical artificial intelligence (AI) technologies are increasingly being introduced into hospital practice, yet evidence describing their operational integration and performance after deployment in routine clinical settings remains limited. This study examined the real-world implementation and operational integration of clinical AI within a provincial tertiary health system in China over an 18-month observation period.

pmc-13682685.description: Caregiver burden is a significant issue post‐stroke. [FR Doc No: 99-28980] ----------------------------------------------------------------------- DEPARTMENT OF COMMERCE International Trade Administration U.S. Government Trade Event Information Request ACTION: Proposed collection; comment request. ----------------------------------------------------------------------- SUMMARY: The Department of Commerce, as part of its continuing effort to reduce paperwork and respondent burdens, invites the general public and other Federal agencies to take this opportunity.
